prompts.title: Concept explainer, 12 s
prompts.when: An abstract idea needs a visual model, no product screenshots available.
prompts.text: Explain one abstract concept in 12 seconds using only geometry and type — no stock imagery. Structure: (1) 0-3 s, three labelled nodes appear at triangle vertices with 0.12 s stagger, connectors draw on with scaleX over 0.5 s; (2) 3-7 s, emphasise one node by dimming the other two to 35% opacity, and surface a one-line definition beside it; (3) 7-11 s, show the relationship changing: one connector thickens and the label updates; (4) 11-12 s, hold on the resolved diagram, no motion. Maximum 12 words total on screen at any moment.

prompts.title: Before / after mechanism
prompts.when: The value is a reduction or a simplification that a comparison makes obvious.
prompts.text: Build an 8-second split comparison. Left panel mounts with 6 boxes and 11 connectors (label it 'before'), right panel with 3 boxes and 4 connectors ('after'). Left enters sliding from the left over 0.45 s, right from the right with the same duration starting 0.1 s later — they must not arrive together. At 3.5 s, draw a vertical divider between them with scaleY. From 4 s, the extra boxes on the left fade to 20% opacity one by one (stagger 0.15) while the right side gets a subtle accent outline. Hold the contrast for 2 s. Counts on screen must be exactly the counts drawn.

prompts.title: Three-step sequence
prompts.when: A process has a fixed number of steps and order matters.
prompts.text: Create a 9-second three-step explainer: a horizontal rail with three numbered stops. The rail draws left to right over 0.7 s; stop 1 pops in, its caption follows 0.2 s later; then the rail continues to stop 2, caption, stop 3, caption — each leg 2.4 s, motion never overlapping with a caption read. Keep captions to 5 words. The currently active stop is at full opacity with an accent dot; completed stops dim to 60%; the upcoming stop sits at 30% and only becomes opaque when reached. End with all three visible for 1 s.
